lines: Notice that invisible character needs to be used here,
otherwise it has a small glitch where the user goes
behind the stair for a frame.
Check the second page of the event as well, as it is important!

list.text: \f[kimono]\rI was waiting for you, \PN! I found a hidden ladder!\nCome with me!
\f[faceArcher]Archer: \c[4]That Kimono Girl ran past and I couldn't stop her...\nBut my subordinates will take care of her.\nYou can be sure about that.
\f[faceArcher]\c[4]You had a ton of luck in the Goldenrod Radio Tower...\nBut I'll not allow the same to happen again.
\f[faceArcher]\c[4]We can not allow you to ruin our plan to catch the Legenday Pokémon!

lines: EndSpeech: Não posso acreditar!!!

then.text: \f[faceArcher]\c[4]Even this defeat will not be enough to stop us from moving forward with this plan!

list.text: \f[faceProton]\bI'll not allow you to interfere on our big plan!

lines: EndSpeech: Isso não vai ficar assim!

then.text: \f[faceProton]\bTeam Rocket is always working below the surface...\nYou'll not be able to stop our plan this time.

list.text: \f[facePetrel]Petrel: Do you think you finished us in Goldenrod?!
\f[facePetrel]We have our best members guarding this cave, you will not get away with it!

lines: EndSpeech: O chefe será alertado sobre isso!

list.text: \f[faceAriana]\rAriana: Oh! It's the brave little kid again...
\f[faceAriana]\rIt was a mistake for you to come here, you are in big trouble now!

lines: EndSpeech: Droga!Garoto(a) insolente!

then.text: \f[faceAriana]\rThe Tidal Bell you're looking for is not with me.\nAt this point our boss already got it's hands on it!\nYou'll never get it back!

list.text: \f[kimono]\rThanks for coming here to help me recover my Tidal Bell...
\f[kimono]\rTeam Rocket members in black suits have been running around here...
\f[kimono]\rI'm sure they are doing something bad here.
\f[kimono]\rI'm looking for a hidden ladder, I'm sure I saw some of them going down, but then the ladder just vanished!
\f[kimono]\rI fear for the legendary Pokémon Lugia...
